text_block_list.text:
I placed... I suppose that counts as a
good result.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But I'm not about to stop here. After all,
I'm a
top-class Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: You know what I mean, right?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: The King I know is always moving forward!
I'm sure you'll get a first-rate result next time.

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! That's right! I am Кинг Хало,
after all.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Nothing less than first-rate and first
place will do
for this century's premier
Umamusume!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Naturally! It seems you do understand.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Thus, I expect you to work through the
night,
coming up with a first-rate
training plan and an
equally worthy
strategy!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm looking forward to your
first-rate
efforts for this first-rate
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The only thing fit for a king is a throne.
And next
time, I intend on claiming it!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
